name: TriwarM Global
storyline:
The world of Tria has long been divided among three great factions:
Glacion of the frozen highlands, Lindel of the deep forests, and
Halakan of the desert wastes. With the throne of Tria left empty,
each faction claims the sole right to rule the world.

Players pledge themselves to one of the three factions and take part
in an endless war of field battles, sieges, and territorial conquest.
Three factions, one ambition — and only one throne.
summary:
TriwarM Global : 3-Faction War is a mobile MMORPG in which three factions —
Glacion, Lindel, and Halakan — fight for control of the world of Tria.
Players take part in large-scale faction warfare including field battles,
sieges, and territory control, alongside character progression systems such
as gear enhancement, refinement, awakening, pets, and constellations.
The game features dungeons, raids, field bosses, and battle passes, and
operates as a live service on Android with four regional servers and
support for ten languages.
